story.name: MySQL Account Takeover (ATO) - Time-Based Pattern (5 Hours)
story.description: Simulates normal access pattern (50 SELECTs on object1 for 4 hours) followed by sudden access to all 5 objects (250 SELECTs total in hour 5) to detect account takeover. Pattern: Object1 only → 1 hour → Object1 only → 1 hour → Object1 only → 1 hour → Object1 only → 1 hour → ALL 5 OBJECTS SPIKE

story.name: MySQL Data Tampering - Time-Based Anomaly (5 Hours)
story.description: Simulates data tampering attack with time-based anomaly pattern in DELETE operations. Establishes normal baseline (50 DELETEs/hour for 4 hours) followed by massive spike (1000 DELETEs in hour 5) to detect unauthorized bulk data deletion. Pattern: Pre-cleanup → Create table → Insert 2000 records → 50 DELETEs → 1 hour → 50 DELETEs → 1 hour → 50 DELETEs → 1 hour → 50 DELETEs → 1 hour → 1000 DELETE SPIKE
story.author: SLP Team
story.outcomes: Understand how Guardium detects time-based anomalies in data deletion patterns, specifically identifying sudden spikes in DELETE operations that deviate from established baselines. Learn to recognize data tampering attacks through temporal analysis of DML operations.
